A realistic, continuous 14-second video. From the very first frame, the woman from the reference image is already standing in the final scene: dark bob just past the collarbone, thin round graphite glasses on her face, pale-blue stand-collar shirt with turned cuffs (not the dark overshirt), charcoal trousers, tiny matte silver stud earrings, black nylon-strap watch on her left wrist, bare right wrist, holding a bright neon-yellow marker in her right hand, standing in front of a transparent glass board against a matte black background -- never the reference photo's own plain indoor background or outfit, not even for a single frame. Fixed camera, medium-wide, straight-on, studio lighting, same framing for the entire clip with no establishing shot, no warm-up frame, no transition into the scene. Board blank at start. Glass is perfectly clear -- no reflection of her, no mirrored double, no ghost image, no second figure anywhere; exactly one woman visible throughout. Her face, hair, glasses and wardrobe match the reference image's bench look exactly and do not change during the clip.

She writes exactly four short lines, top to bottom, left-aligned, generous blank space between them, small compact handwriting staying on one line each, never wrapping:
1. "Human-in-the-loop review"
2. "for AI in production."
3. "Pay $5 per person-hour."
4. "https://services.deepen.ai"
Each line reproduced exactly, character for character, including every hyphen: line 1 has a hyphen between "Human" and "in", another between "in" and "the", and another between "the" and "loop" -- three hyphens total, none skipped. "$5" is a dollar sign then "5", no period or extra digit. The URL is exactly "https://services.deepen.ai", all lowercase. Between "services" and "deepen" there is a small round dot sitting on the baseline (a period) -- never a horizontal dash or hyphen, and never a forward slash either, only the double forward slash right after "https:" and nowhere else in the URL. The mark between "deepen" and "ai" is the same small round dot, not a dash and not a slash. No trailing slash or extra characters.

Order: write line 1, lift, write line 2 below it, lift, write line 3, lift, write line 4 below it, lift. Ink appears only under the moving tip, never ahead, never all at once. Marker lifts the instant a line finishes -- no stray mark after any line. All four lines, including the full URL on line 4 down to its last character, are completely finished and the marker has lifted away from line 4 before any annotation begins -- she never starts circling or underlining while any line is still only partly written.

Only once all four lines are fully written: draw a closed circle tightly around "$5" (line 3), one curved stroke growing under the tip. Then, after the circle is finished, one straight line under the full URL on line 4 only, matching only that line's width, no overshoot onto blank space.

Every stroke stops right at its endpoint -- no overshoot, no arrowhead. Prior text/marks stay stationary, never redrawn. Her face never changes. She looks at the board throughout, camera only at the very end. No cuts or zooms. Consistent yellow line thickness, sharp edges.

Photorealistic, single continuous take, 30fps, high temporal consistency, no animation overlays.
